plan:
Ramp, then build a standardized board. Make a land drop every turn and cast mana rocks and land fetchers
first. Cast Atraxa (W/U/B/G) once you have its colours; proliferate every turn with her and other
proliferate cards. Grow a wide board of artifact creatures and tokens with +1/+1 counters: Steel Overseer,
Throne of Geth and other counter engines are the payoff. Spend your mana every turn. Removal and wraths do
nothing against these opponents: hold them.
